'''Carnivorous plants''' were [[Plant/Legends|plants]] that [[Diet/Legends|consumed]] animal flesh. Numerous distinct [[Species/Legends|species]] of carnivorous plant lived in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], each with unique feeding mechanisms best suited to the capture and consumption of living prey in their own environment.<ref name="Planets of the Galaxy" /><ref name="MTM" />
